entities.summary: Arpat Avanesyan is a Physicist and legislator from Artsakh. Avanesyan is a past Rector of the State University of Mountainous Karabakh. He chairs the legislature's Finance Committee. Arpat Avanesjan was a scientists & inventors from Chartar (b. 1944-06-02, Chartar). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
